description: This PHP class `HeaderProcessor` processes HTTP headers, specifically parsing the headers to extract HTTP version, status code, reason phrase, and headers array.

classes.name: HeaderProcessor
classes.description: A final class that provides a static method to parse HTTP header arrays and extract relevant HTTP response information.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses an array of header lines to return HTTP version, status code, reason phrase, and headers array. Throws exceptions if the input is invalid or missing critical data.
